clips.h3_prompt: 2D hand-drawn single-character narrative sequence, 15 seconds. STYLE IDENTITY LOCK: follow Picture 1 for the adventurer’s original drawing language, material boundaries and established dark teal-black cloak, purple cloth, red scarf and straps, white metal bracket and cyan lantern; follow Picture 2 for the mechanical-airfield palette logic. Use clear readable shape separation, restrained line variation, light watercolor-thin transitions and soft diffuse light only where compatible with both references; do not recolor or rematerialize the character. CHARACTER (Picture 1): exactly one broad, heavy adult male adventurer with short dark hair, a thick beard, tired experienced eyes, layered worn cloak, backpack and rolled load, crossing straps, heavy gloves and boots, and one cyan-lit lantern attached at his waist. ENVIRONMENT (Picture 2): preserve the same mechanical-airfield stable-result location, its existing elements, spatial identity and palette relationships; the reference defines the place, not one mandatory framing. CAMERA AND COMPOSITION: static slightly elevated wide shot, the single adventurer occupies the lower-left third while the verified environment carries the middle and background; preserve generous negative space and do not invent new structures. ACTION: he stands still under the load. The waist lantern makes one small pendulum swing as his equipment weight settles. His eyes lower toward it. One gloved hand reaches down, catches the lantern body, and holds it still. End with both feet planted and the lantern secured. Maintain exactly one character and continuous location.

clips.h3_prompt: 2D hand-drawn single-character narrative sequence, 15 seconds. Continue from the Work-selected ending frame of clip A with the same one adult adventurer in the same mechanical-airfield stable-result location. STYLE IDENTITY LOCK: preserve Picture 1’s original face, body mass, worn layered cloak, red scarf and straps, purple cloth, white metal bracket, backpack, heavy gloves and boots, cyan lantern, drawing language, materials and colors; preserve Picture 2’s location identity and palette logic. VISUAL EXPRESSION: begin on the same screen direction and slowly push from a medium-wide shot to a medium-full shot, keeping the adventurer on the same left-third axis and the same verified background relationships; no new object or reverse angle. ACTION: he holds the caught lantern still. He turns his wrist slightly so the cyan light faces down and forward. His shoulders draw back a few centimeters to rebalance the backpack. The cloak and straps settle once, the lantern light becomes steady, and he stops in a compact grounded stance. Exactly one character; no cut, no location replacement and no redesign.
